title: EffectiveDatingKernelRegistry
description: Local/static AC-0.6 registry for the ontology-kernel bitemporal effective-dating primitive. It validates the Rust kernel type surface, Buck2 target wiring, and GOOD/BAD fixtures without claiming live cloud-ci authority or Phase-0 completion.

_meta.source_request: Founder directives: keep Phase-0 honest, Buck2-native, Rust-first, modern, hyperscaler-oriented, and suitable; use Buck2-native LLVM source-based coverage over Tarpaulin; keep Cargo mutation testing advisory only in the dual Cargo.toml + Buck2/Reindeer setup.

official_references.name: Buck2 docs — build command
official_references.used_for: Records Buck2 build target execution as local/static gate evidence and Build ID source.

official_references.name: Buck2 docs — test command
official_references.used_for: Records the intended Buck2-native test surface while this host uses a genrule rustc --test shim for the pure kernel module.

official_references.name: Rustc Book — Instrumentation-based Code Coverage
official_references.used_for: Keeps modern Rust coverage direction aligned to rustc/LLVM source-based coverage under Buck2 target evidence.

official_references.name: Reindeer
official_references.used_for: Records the dual Cargo.toml plus generated BUCK graph monorepo ergonomics for dependency graph maintenance and local Cargo mutation-testing feedback.

claim_boundary.note: Fixture-backed local/static effective-dating kernel evidence only. This gate does not run live cloud-ci, post statuses, mutate branch protection, prove P0.0 green, prove Phase-0 completion, prove production readiness, or prove hyperscaler-grade readiness.

required_shape_invariants: EffectiveInstant, EffectiveTimeRange, BitemporalRange, EffectiveDatedVersion, and EffectiveDatedHistory are public ontology-kernel primitives
valid_time and transaction_time are half-open ranges with open-ended support
as_of(valid_at, transaction_at) returns the correct version or NoVersionAtAsOf
overlapping valid-time ranges are rejected when their transaction-time windows overlap
out-of-order transaction-time inserts are sorted deterministically and remain queryable without lost or duplicated versions

modern_rust_standards_record.coverage_noncanonical_surface: Tarpaulin is not the canonical coverage surface
modern_rust_standards_record.coverage_instrumentation: rustc -C instrument-coverage with LLVM_PROFILE_FILE, llvm-profdata merge, and llvm-cov report/export under Buck2 target evidence
modern_rust_standards_record.mutation_local_ergonomics: Dual Cargo.toml + Buck2/Reindeer setup keeps local Cargo mutation testing advisory for developer feedback while Buck2/cloud-ci captured evidence remains merge authority.
modern_rust_standards_record.hyperscaler_orientation: The kernel gate is deterministic, target-addressable, fixture-backed, data-class annotated, bitemporal, non-claiming, and suitable for trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci promotion.
